metadata.label: Monochrome
metadata.coverage: Voyager 2 clear-filter imagery registered to the PDS Stooke shape. Measured sky-background subtraction and bounded illumination correction reduce photographed shading. Gray grid marks unavailable or unreliable samples. The distant hemisphere and cast shadows are not reconstructed.

metadata.label: False color
metadata.coverage: Voyager green, blue and violet filters displayed as red, green and blue. Only the common reliable interior is shown. Registration and blur limit interpretation to broad patterns at roughly 40 km or coarser; small colored details are noise or uncertain. This is not true color or a calibrated albedo map.

celestial.sunSource: JPL Neptune-system ephemeris and IAU/WGCCRE rotation; the Stooke source origin and west-positive longitude are preserved.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.notes: Voyager 2 clear-filter imagery registered to the PDS Stooke shape. Measured sky-background subtraction and bounded illumination correction reduce photographed shading. Gray grid marks unavailable or unreliable samples. The distant hemisphere and cast shadows are not reconstructed. Fine grain is largely source-image noise and must not be interpreted as resolved terrain.

controls.label: False color
controls.notes: Voyager green, blue and violet filters are displayed as red, green and blue. Only their common reliable interior is mapped; the gray grid marks unknown samples. Blur and registration uncertainty limit interpretation to broad patterns at roughly 40 km or coarser near the image centre. Small colored details can be image noise or registration error. This is not true color or a calibrated albedo map.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.notes: Radial height above a 208 km reference sphere from Stooke’s Voyager-derived shape model. Shows the broad irregular shape, not local height above a geoid. The archived 5° radius grid includes modeled unseen terrain and can exaggerate facets or depressions. Small craters are not resolved.
